owner.O1.subject: DebateAI tax summary for {quarter}
owner.O1.intro: Here is the tax summary for {quarter}, built from our own charge records. Each line shows the country or state, net sales, tax collected, whether we are registered there, and where and by when to pay.
owner.O2.subject: A refund could not be completed and needs your attention
owner.O2.intro: xMoney refused a refund we asked for, or its outcome stayed unknown after every retry. No more tries are made by themselves.
owner.O2.next: Check this charge in the xMoney dashboard and settle the refund by hand there. The owner summary lists it until then.
owner.O2.notRequestedIntro: A refund job was stopped before anything was sent to xMoney: it does not match any refund request our records hold for this payment. No money moved, and no more tries are made.
owner.O2.notRequestedAmount: Amount the job named: {refundAmount}. This is only the job's own figure, not a refund to make.
owner.O2.notRequestedNext: Do not refund anything for this job. Something able to write to the billing database queued it, so tell whoever runs the server. They check this charge's own refund requests: a request that was never refunded is still owed.
owner.O2.otherSystemIntro: A refund job was stopped before anything was sent to xMoney: the payment it names was taken in the other xMoney system (sandbox or live), which this server does not use. No money moved.
owner.O2.otherSystemNext: Nothing is owed on this server. If it was a real customer's payment in the other system, refund it in that system's dashboard; a sandbox test payment needs nothing. The owner summary lists it as REFUND_OTHER_SYSTEM.
owner.O2.withdrawalDeadline: This is a withdrawal refund: the law requires it to be made by {refundDeadline} at the latest (14 days after the withdrawal). First look at this payment in the xMoney dashboard. If it already shows a refund of {refundAmount}, an earlier attempt went through: do not refund again; the site records it at its daily check, and the customer's refund email (M8) follows by itself. If it shows none, refund exactly {refundAmount} on this payment, in one refund, so the site records it and M8 follows by itself.
owner.O2_WITHDRAWAL.subject: A withdrawal needs you to settle its refund by hand
owner.O2_WITHDRAWAL.intro: A customer withdrew from their plan, and the plan has ended. A refund made in the xMoney dashboard, or an earlier refund request, already touched one of their payments, so the site could not work out what is still due. Nothing has been refunded for this withdrawal yet.
owner.O2_WITHDRAWAL.deadline: Withdrawn on {withdrawalDate}. The law requires the refund to be made by {refundDeadline} at the latest (14 days after the withdrawal).
owner.O2_WITHDRAWAL.next: Work out what is still due as the runbook describes ("A withdrawal sent by email or on the model form"), refund in the xMoney dashboard what the site cannot, then record the settlement with pnpm billing:withdraw --owner {ownerRef} --refund <amount> --dashboard <amount>. The customer's refund email (M8) follows. The owner summary lists it as WITHDRAWAL_BY_OWNER until then.
owner.O3.subject: A legal document or a required email was not sent and needs your attention
owner.O3.intro: A job that issues an invoice or a credit note, or that sends an email, stopped after its last try. That job is not tried again by itself; only the notice of a changed renewal amount (M3) is sent again, by the renewal.
owner.O3.listed: The owner summary (pnpm billing:tax-summary, and the quarterly email) lists it until it is settled.
